shorts.title: What REALLY Crashed at Roswell? 🔍 Meatball Investigates
shorts.description:
What if I told you the Roswell cover-up was real... just not for aliens? Project Mogul's balloons carried microphones to listen for Soviet nuclear tests. The Air Force's reports came out in 1994-1997.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths
